name: Exp_ColorMETRO_WPR
summary: This EA uses the ColorMETRO_WPR custom indicator, which combines Williams' Percent Range (WPR) with a step-based metro signal, to generate buy and sell entries. It detects crossover signals between the indicator's two buffers (MPlus and MMinus) to open and close positions. Trade execution is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms library for position sizing and order management.
summary_zh: 该EA使用ColorMETRO_WPR自定义指标，结合威廉指标(WPR)和阶梯式Metro信号来产生买卖入场信号。通过检测指标两个缓冲区(MPlus和MMinus)的交叉来开仓和平仓，交易执行委托给TradeAlgorithms库进行仓位管理和订单处理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorMETRO_WPR指标的双线交叉信号，该指标融合了威廉百分比范围(WPR)与快慢两档步长(StepSizeFast/StepSizeSlow)的阶梯过滤机制。入场条件为：当MPlus线从下方穿越MMinus线时产生做多信号，反之当MPlus线从上方穿越MMinus线时产生做空信号，且仅在上一根K线确认方向而当前K线发生交叉时触发。出场条件包括反向信号平仓以及固定点数的止损(StopLoss_)和止盈(TakeProfit_)，同时支持通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose开关单独控制反向平仓功能。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举提供五种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按净自由保证金比例、按净余额比例和固定手数。资金管理采用TradeAlgorithms库封装的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数，支持滑点控制(Deviation_)和信号时间戳过滤。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺少加仓、减仓和追踪止损等高级资金管理功能。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover signals of the ColorMETRO_WPR indicator's two buffer lines (MPlus and MMinus), which integrate Williams' Percent Range with a dual-step-size metro filtering mechanism using fast (StepSizeFast=5) and slow (StepSizeSlow=15) step sizes. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when MPlus crosses above MMinus (confirmed by prior bar direction and current bar crossover), and a sell signal triggers when MPlus crosses below MMinus under the same confirmation logic. Exit conditions include closing on opposite signals (controllable via BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans) and fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points) levels. Position sizing supports five money management modes via the MM parameter and MMMode enum: free margin percentage, balance percentage, net free margin percentage, net balance percentage, and fixed lot size, with the default set to fixed lot (0.1). The EA delegates order execution to the TradeAlgorithms library which handles slippage control (Deviation_=10 points) and signal timestamp filtering (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime). The overall strategy logic is clear and systematic, but lacks advanced features such as partial close, scale-in, or trailing stop functionality.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金分配比例或固定手数

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/净自由保证金/净余额/固定手数）

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许做多平仓（反向信号时）
parameters.description_en: Allow closing long positions (on reverse signal)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许做空平仓（反向信号时）
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions (on reverse signal)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号确认K线索引（0=当前K线）
parameters.description_en: Signal confirmation bar index (0 = current bar)

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于指标交叉信号，易于理解和验证
支持五种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同资金管理需求
买卖方向的开仓和平仓可独立控制，提供细粒度的交易开关
使用新K线检测(IsNewBar)避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易
止损止盈参数齐全，且盈亏比默认为2:1，具有正期望值倾向
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on indicator crossover signals, easy to understand and verify
Supports five position sizing modes, offering flexible money management options
Buy/sell open and close can be independently toggled, providing granular trade control
Uses new bar detection (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Complete stop-loss and take-profit parameters with a default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, favoring positive expectancy
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标ColorMETRO_WPR和TradeAlgorithms库，缺少独立性和可移植性
缺少追踪止损功能，固定止盈可能限制趋势行情中的盈利空间
没有点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在高点差或低流动性时段可能产生不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点对于大多数品种来说数值偏大，未做品种适配
信号逻辑仅依赖单一指标交叉，缺少多重确认和过滤机制，可能产生较多假信号
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator ColorMETRO_WPR and TradeAlgorithms library, lacking independence and portability
No trailing stop functionality; fixed take-profit may limit profit potential in strong trending moves
No spread filter or trading session filter, potentially leading to unfavorable fills during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
Stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large for most instruments without instrument-specific adaptation
Signal logic relies solely on single indicator crossover without multi-confirmation or filtering mechanisms, potentially generating many false signals
improvements: 增加追踪止损功能，在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润，避免固定止盈过早离场
添加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在流动性不足或点差过大时入场
增加多时间框架确认机制，例如高周期趋势方向过滤，减少低周期假信号
根据品种ATR动态计算止损止盈，替代固定点数，提高策略的品种适应性
improvements_en: Add trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits during trending moves and avoid premature exits from fixed take-profit
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to prevent entries during low liquidity or excessive spread conditions
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., higher timeframe trend direction filter, to reduce false signals on lower timeframes
Use ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculation instead of fixed point values, improving instrument adaptability

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，在点差扩大时可能导致不利成交和滑点损失
固定止损止盈点数未根据品种波动率适配，某些品种可能止损过宽或过窄
依赖外部库和指标，若这些依赖缺失或更新可能导致EA无法正常运行
risk_points_en: No spread filter; unfavorable fills and slippage losses may occur when spreads widen
Fixed stop-loss/take-profit points are not adapted to instrument volatility, potentially too wide or too narrow for certain instruments
Dependency on external library and indicator; if these are missing or updated, the EA may fail to function properly
